13311:soul:2162.behavior: 复用原3838a9fb、已授权Wiki身份390296与API技能魂印；原API pet404具体原因保留，不改源。仅补原混合队伍分支的正式记录：战初真实同方共享四记录，只有绑定源原位置的SP持有同一资源对象，双方独立；真实前三次第五及换出后恢复远古圣灵，最后异常记录需真实敌方致死，移除历史和共享对象跨真实成员保持。源须原hash、存活、场下且未消逝，经双方活薇尔诗的公共场下目标限制，才让在场队友施加已移除对应记录的弱化、异常、固定、百分比时穿透相应免疫与面板抗性。未移除、活薇尔诗封指定、死源/无为实际消逝源均无穿透；免疫资格不消费，异常抵抗不额外抽签，真实米斯蒂克攻击禁异常不被绕过。最新用户更正不穿透暴击抗性，原必暴红0、固定50；裁决明确固粉减伤50→47及原莫塔里安护罩300→250仍保留，敌SP致死免疫可穿透但不改敌方神魂记录和属性。只签原跨成员分支，不代签29503/1669、整只、显示新验收或冻结门槛。

success.name: 4876/1828第五命中零红仍消双盾罩并附消除值50%粉，928清回合成功次数免异，713/1772各自按真实正负段数15固定
success.assertion: test('4876/1828第五命中零红仍消双盾罩并附消除值50%粉，928清回合成功次数免异，713/1772各自按真实正负段数15固定',()=>{const s=make(row(1828)),S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],1000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),750);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);for(const protect of[false,true]){const a=make(row(928));if(protect)timer(a,1,'protect');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,protect?0:1);}for(const id of[713,1772]){const a=make(row(id));a.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;a.fighters[0].stages.spe=1;a.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;a.fighters[1].stages.spa=-3;turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),id===713?45:75);}});

success.name: 4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费
success.assertion: test('4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1828));S.refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let remaining;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='attackDamageTaken'&&c.a.side===1)remaining=(c.a.suitState.shield??0)+(c.a.suitState.barrier??0);},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(remaining<2500&&remaining>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:Math.floor(remaining*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}const a=make(row(928));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);timer(a,1,'攻击必中');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a,29277));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

boundary.assertion: test('4876/1828消除值按技能红伤后剩余双盾罩计算，粉免仍清除；928同源次数刷新及191回合反弹优先不消费',()=>{const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js');for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1828));S.refresh(s.fighters[1],2000,'shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'barrier');if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');let remaining;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='attackDamageTaken'&&c.a.side===1)remaining=(c.a.suitState.shield??0)+(c.a.suitState.barrier??0);},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(remaining<2500&&remaining>0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:Math.floor(remaining*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}const a=make(row(928));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);timer(a,1,'攻击必中');turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a,29277));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});
